# b3-v1 card 1 — strategist, 2026-11-21 (saved by Jarvis; the agent cannot write files). Argument, no goldfish.

Teferi's Protection in, Sapphire Medallion out.
- Weakest slot: Medallion discounts blue only; no draw/protect/kill; six rocks + 35 lands; Heliod's discount is the cost-cutter. A rock, so the land rule is untouched.
- Heliod's protection now: he is an Enchantment Creature → Greater Auramancy gives shroud, Karametra's Blessing hexproof + indestructible; Spellskite, Guardian of Faith (flash phase-out), Flawless Maneuver. Targeted removal well covered (strategy:multiplayer.commander-insurance).
- The gap is NON-targeted loss: wrath, edict, the Armageddon of 003. Teferi's Protection phases out everything incl. lands + protection from everything — the one card answering all at once. It was one of the branch's cuts (staged 2026-11-12 for Flawless Maneuver, "try: blind") — check it was deliberate.
- Forced-draw kill closes on paper: Psychosis Crawler pings every opponent per YOUR draw → ~40 draws, not 40×3; Ageless Insight doubles; Mathemagics X=5 → 32, X=6 → 64 draws; needs the Crawler (5) alive + ~12-14 mana. Scrawling Crawler taxes each opponent per THEIR draw; Prosperity/Fascination X≈20 hits all three; Forced Fruition 7 per opponent spell. Protecting the Crawler matters as much as Heliod; Protection covers both.
- Fort already five pieces (Prison, Propaganda, Sphere, Second Doctor, Auramancy); add nothing.
- Next: Swiftfoot Boots for Flawless Maneuver; Fierce Guardianship for Isochron Scepter (Jarvis: Fierce Guardianship is a Game Changer — the branch holds three, so this is OUT at B3).
- Dissent: Maneuver is free, Protection costs 3 on a counter-mana turn; Protection phases out your own Crawler and fort for a turn; "protection is for the A team" rule → protection dense already → NO CHANGE defensible; Medallion discounts Mathemagics/Fruition/Zenith, which a rock count hides.
Needs: stack scenario Mathemagics + Insight + Crawler; forge-cast-check on Teferi's Protection.

# Heliod discount + Approach casts — rules-question, 2026-11-21 (saved by Jarvis; the agent cannot write files)

Heliod, the Warped Eclipse (verbatim): "You may cast spells as though they had flash. Spells you cast cost {1} less to cast for each card your opponents have drawn this turn."

(a) Discount: "this turn" = the current turn, so casting on an opponent's turn counts their draws that turn; the count locks in at 601.2f. Reduces only generic, after X is chosen (ruling 2023-04-14: {X}{R} with two opp draws → X=5 for {3}{R}). Approach {6}{W} → {W} with six opponent draws. Commander tax IS reducible: 903.8 + 601.2f (additional costs applied before reductions; ruling 2023-04-14).
(b) Approach: the second cast must be from hand; the first may be cast from anywhere (ruling 2017-04-18); a card changing zones is a new object (400.7) so the same card recast later is "another spell". A COUNTERED first Approach still counts (ruling 2017-04-18: checks whether the first was cast, not resolved) — so Mystic Sanctuary → top → draw → cast wins. Flash via Heliod changes timing only; still from hand. A COPY is not cast (707.10; ruling 2017-04-18) and counts as neither. If the second is countered, no win (ruling 2017-07-14).
(c) Forced Fruition + Smothering Tithe: seven separate Tithe triggers per opponent spell (121.2 one at a time; 603.2c); the opponent draws all seven before paying (Tithe ruling 2023-09-01); not optional (Fruition ruling). Those seven count for Heliod's discount if drawn before your cost locks in.
Not settled: interleaving order when Fruition draws and your cast happen the same turn.

Static: Dictate of Kruphix, Howling Mine, Font of Mythos (+2). Targeted X: Mathemagics (2^X), Stroke of Genius, Blue Sun's Zenith. Targeted fixed: Archmage's Charm mode, Gleaming Splendor ({2}{W} two players), Loran. Opponents only: Forced Fruition (7 per spell); Arcane Denial's rider.
(b) Payoffs: Scrawling Crawler (opp draw: lose 1), Smothering Tithe, Gleaming Splendor + Faerie Mastermind (opp second draw), Psychosis Crawler (your draw: each opp loses 1), Rhystic Study; Heliod back face discount.
(c) Doublers: Teferi's Ageless Insight and Bard — identical "except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two instead"; compounding unchecked.
(d) Approach finders: Mystical, Personal Tutor, Solve the Equation, Long-Term Plans, Drift of Phantasms (transmute), Dig Through Time, Top, Scroll Rack, Mystic Sanctuary.
(e) Win protection: Teferi TR, Silence, Pact of Negation.
(f) Heliod protection: Karametra's Blessing (hexproof+indestructible; he is an enchantment creature), Greater Auramancy (shroud), Flawless Maneuver, Guardian of Faith (phase out others), Spellskite. No equipment, no flicker.
(g) Counters (all hard): Counterspell, Arcane Denial, Dovin's Veto (noncreature), Force of Negation (noncreature), An Offer (noncreature), Archmage's Charm mode, Pact of Negation. Venser is bounce.
(h) Removal: Swords, Path, Winds of Abandon (overload exiles theirs), Ballista, Loran (art/ench), Teferi -3, Venser; Eiganjo, Otawara channels; mass: Supreme Verdict, Austere Command, Winds overload.
(i) Fort: Ghostly Prison, Propaganda, Sphere of Safety, Second Doctor. Enchantments in the 99: 12 (13 with Heliod).
(j) Rocks 5: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Azorius Signet, Fellwar, Talisman of Progress; Sapphire Medallion a reducer. (k) No max hand size: Folio, Second Doctor.
Curve MV 0:2 1:11 2:20 3:17 4:7 5:2 6:3 7+:2. MV≥5: Psychosis Crawler, Sphere, Austere Command, Bard, Forced Fruition, Approach, Dig. X spells: Prosperity, Fascination, Folio, Mathemagics, Stroke, Zenith, Ballista.

Stacks (pass): 002 Approach second cast off Mystical Tutor; 007 Approach under Teferi TR. Named but not in branch: Swan Song, Ancient Tomb (002), Fierce Guardianship (007, in an opponent's hand). 72 of 84 branch entries in no stack.

Crawler arithmetic: 40 Psychosis triggers kill every opponent at once; 40 draws bare; ~20 non-first draw events with Insight; 10 if Insight + Bard compound (unverified). Scrawling Crawler taxes opponents' draws; its upkeep draw is symmetric.

Opponents: no seat runs mass land destruction (name match). Creature exile: zur 2 (Swords, Path); the rest 0. Chaos Warp: tannuk, purphoros, krenko, magda 1 each. Assassin's Trophy: teval.
